spanish: Y hizo travesaños, maderas de shitím: cinco a las tablas del costado del mishkán el uno,

findings.issue: Plural construct בְּרִיחֵי is bars of the following wood; the comma drops that of-relation.
Common noun שִׁטִּים is left as the untranslated loan shitím.
Common noun הַמִּשְׁכָּן is left as the untranslated loan mishkán.
Feminine singular cardinal הָאֶחָת is rendered with masculine el uno.

notes: Y hizo matches the qal wayyiqtol 3ms, and cinco matches the masculine cardinal.
